Lounge space, a brief notice later this week
We write to travelers

Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is managing a few routine service updates and checking every animal booking with extra care. Please keep all pet travel paperwork close at hand and be ready for a quick review when you reach the desk.

Our team is handling each case in order and recording service changes in the desk ledger as they come in. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. If a booking needs more review, we will move it through a calm stepwise check rather than rushing it along. That keeps the process steady for travelers and for animals alike.

If you are bringing a pet, please make sure its carrier, comfort items, and contact details are easy to confirm. Nala, and other travelers' animals, will be handled with care, but only when the details line up cleanly.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help, updates, and a quick check of your travel file.
